captureContract.authorization: Future separately authorized supported-host session only. Current task forbids browser/visual execution, accounts and live-host changes.
captureContract.accountRules: Use allocated authorized test Profiles/accounts. Do not publish credentials, authenticated URLs, private browsing data or account identifiers. Record aliases and authorization references only.
captureContract.captureRules: Pair screenshots of relevant before/after states with a recording for transitions and focus return. Record the real action, UI label, keyboard path and result. Screenshots alone cannot prove uninterrupted native-window or page identity. No recording duration, frame-rate, timeout or quota is specified.
captureContract.resultRules: Record OBSERVED only for executed actions with linked evidence. Separate UNREACHABLE_LOGIN, RETIRED_DOCUMENTED, NOT_FOUND_IN_BUILD, UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENTED, BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT and NOT_RUN. A disabled control, static selector, fetch failure or missing capture is not a pass or proof of retirement.
captureContract.nativeBoundary: Reference UX capture is not downstream native implementation evidence. Arcified still needs real native window, Profile, page/document and command-target instrumentation in installed builds.
